about: Boards (H1 combat teeth, docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md item 6): a table arena made a board to play on rather than an open field. By place id (ArenaPlaces.IdFor), the table-night tiers it applies at; a place or tier with no board is made as it was. Numbers described in logic/Content/Boards.cs; the shape's generation is logic/Maps/ArenaBoard.cs and the place's own (Arenas/Hollow.cs). Check a board with `dotnet balance/bin/<build>/Balance.dll board --people pack --tier 1 --seed N --out plan.png`. First pass, 3 Nov: the owner, after the tier-1 Deep Shaw, 'the arena survivor area is just too big and theres no strategy to it at all'.
